Topics · Death and what comes after

What happens when I die?

Death brought near through nightly sleep, what the Quran says of the barrier, and a call to return at peace.

Part 1 of 3

﴿ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَٱلَّتِى لَمْ تَمُتْ فِى مَنَامِهَا ۖ فَيُمْسِكُ ٱلَّتِى قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Allāh takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

Quran · Az-Zumar 39:42

Translation

If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath, all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

Original · Hebrew

אִם־יָשִׂ֣ים אֵלָ֣יו לִבּ֑וֹ רוּח֥וֹ וְ֝נִשְׁמָת֗וֹ אֵלָ֥יו יֶאֱסֹֽף׃ יִגְוַ֣ע כָּל־בָּשָׂ֣ר יָ֑חַד וְ֝אָדָ֗ם עַל־עָפָ֥ר יָשֽׁוּב׃

Job · 34:14-15

World English Bible

No one has come back to report. But you have a near experience that repeats every night: you lose the world and yourself, then are given back in the morning without doing anything. The verse puts sleep and death under one act: God takes souls in both, keeps some and sends others back. This is a likeness and no full description. It does make death less strange: a taking, by the One who has returned you every morning.

A question for you

What brought you to this question?

If you sayI have lost someone.
ThenThen read slowly, take what helps, and leave the rest.
If you sayI think about my own death.
ThenFew questions are more honest. The next verse speaks of what a person wishes for at that moment.
If you sayI want to know what is true.
ThenThen go on. You will see what the text says, and also what it does not.

Part 2 of 3

﴿حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ٩٩ لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَـٰلِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ١٠٠﴾

Translation of the meaning

[For such is the state of the disbelievers] until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind."[967] No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.

Translator's notes

[967] Or "in that which I neglected."

Quran · Al-Mu'minun 23:99-100

Translation

Truly we went astray from the way of truth. The light of righteousness didn’t shine for us. The sun didn’t rise for us. We took our fill of the paths of lawlessness and destruction. We traveled through trackless deserts, but we didn’t know the Lord’s way. What did our arrogance profit us? What good have riches and boasting brought us?

Original · Ancient Greek

Ἄρα ἐπλανήθημεν ἀπὸ ὁδοῦ ἀληθείας, καὶ τὸ τῆς δικαιοσύνης φῶς οὐκ ἔλαμψεν ἡμῖν, καὶ ὁ ἥλιος οὐκ ἀνέτειλεν ἡμῖν. Ἀνομίας ἐνεπλήσθημεν τρίβοις καὶ ἀπωλείας, καὶ διωδεύσαμεν ἐρήμους ἀβάτους, τὴν δὲ ὁδὸν Κυρίου οὐκ ἔγνωμεν. Τί ὠφέλησεν ἡμᾶς ἡ ὑπερηφανία; καὶ τὶ πλοῦτος μετὰ ἀλαζονείας συμβέβληται ἡμῖν;

Wisdom · 5:6-8

World English Bible

﴿قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins.[1354] Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

Translator's notes

[1354] For those who repent and correct themselves.

Quran · Az-Zumar 39:53

Translation

Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.

Original · Hebrew

יַעֲזֹ֤ב רָשָׁע֙ דַּרְכּ֔וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אָ֖וֶן מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֑יו וְיָשֹׁ֤ב אֶל־יְהוָה֙ וִֽירַחֲמֵ֔הוּ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ כִּֽי־יַרְבֶּ֥ה לִסְלֽוֹחַ׃

Isaiah · 55:7

World English Bible

These verses report what a person asks for at death: not money, not years of rest, but a chance to do good. That deserves attention. What looks precious at the last moment is the good deed itself. Then the text mentions a barrier until the Day of raising. So death is neither an end nor a way back; it is a passage to what comes after. And you, reading this, still hold what that man wished for.

A question for you

What does the person in the verse ask for?

If you sayTo do good.
ThenThen the last moment reveals what was precious all along, and it is in your hands now.
If you sayTo live longer.
ThenOn the surface, yes. Notice why he wants the time: to do something with it.

Part 3 of 3

﴿يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ٢٧ ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً٢٨ فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى٢٩ وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى٣٠﴾

Translation of the meaning

[To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul, Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him], And enter among My [righteous] servants And enter My Paradise."

Quran · Al-Fajr 89:27-30

Translation

and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.

Original · Hebrew

וְיָשֹׁ֧ב הֶעָפָ֛ר עַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּשֶׁהָיָ֑ה וְהָר֣וּחַ תָּשׁ֔וּב אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְתָנָֽהּ׃

Ecclesiastes · 12:7

World English Bible

If death is a return to the One who made you, the question that matters is how you return. These verses speak of no darkness. They call to a soul at peace: come back to your Lord, pleased and pleasing. The goal drawn here is a meeting with contentment on both sides. You may or may not accept this yet. It is the picture the text offers of how a good life closes: with an invitation.

A question for you

Which word stays with you from these verses?

If you sayAt peace.
ThenThen peace is something you are looking for now, before that Day.
If you sayReturn.
ThenTo hear death as a return is to ask: to whom? That is a question worth carrying.
If you sayI cannot believe this yet.
ThenThat is an honest place to stand. Whether a return is even possible has its own Step.

The same in the other books

who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases, who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies, who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
